name: Portable USB Air Cooler Fan – 3-Speed, Mist Spray, Rechargeable | Random Color
description:
Stay cool anywhere with this portable USB air cooler fan. Features 3-speed airflow and a mist spray function to provide instant relief at your desk, in the car, or while traveling. Lightweight, rechargeable, and ultra-quiet, it combines convenience with comfort for indoor and outdoor use. Built-in LED light adds functionality as a nightlight.
Key Features
 3-Speed Cooling – Gentle to powerful airflow
 Mist Spray Function – Adds refreshing humidity
 USB Rechargeable – 150mAh built-in battery
 Built-in LED Light – Doubles as nightlight
 Tilt-Adjustable & Quiet – Ideal for work, sleep, or travel
 Easy-Fill Water Tank – Continuous mist in seconds
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, electronic components, rechargeable battery
How to Use
 Fill water tank
 Connect USB cable to power source
 Select desired speed and mist function
 Adjust tilt as needed
Package Includes
 1 × Portable USB Air Cooler Fan
 1 × USB Charging Cable
